lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cs₂InAgBr₆ crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with a 40-atom unit cell (Cs₈In₄Ag₄Br₂₄) distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Ag and In centers each as octahedral, coordinated by six Br neighbors, while Cs centers show a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 Br neighbors. Corner-sharing between Ag and In octahedra is observed, and face-sharing occurs between Cs polyhedra and the Ag and In octahedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 40 sites.
